objective: Acquire evaluation-compatible scored human evidence from genuinely independent product repositories without selecting sources or review subjects from security outcomes.

current_gate.shortfall: At least four additional compatible decided labels and one genuinely independent evaluation family are required; both classes must remain represented.

frozen_scoring_identity.compatibility_rule: Every acquired finding must have a stored score with exactly this model name, model version, feature schema, and calibration before human review. Retraining, tuning, or substituting a newer tuple requires a new protocol.

decision_inputs: deployable product rather than tutorial, benchmark, deliberately vulnerable application, or starter template
documented application domain and language/framework diversity
potential to exercise authorization, business workflow, tenant or ownership isolation, or service-boundary reasoning
absence from every existing RepoAuditor acquisition, protected, UAT, and evaluation family
forbidden_inputs: classifier score, rank, predicted class, severity, confidence, or suppression
human label, falsification verdict, benchmark answer key, or exploit result

frozen_sources.selection_basis: A deployable, self-hostable TypeScript document-signing product with authentication, document workflows, teams/organizations, storage, background work, and external-service boundaries.
A deployed Ruby on Rails community product with user, moderator, and administrator workflows and materially different language/framework ancestry from the TypeScript primary.

frozen_sources.activation_condition: Use only if the two primary sources produce fewer than eight classifier-eligible candidates after the frozen filters; record the primary shortfall before materializing this source.

public_metadata_at_freeze.license: repository license requires verification at materialization

frozen_sources.selection_basis: A deployable Rails and Vue customer-support product with account, inbox, agent, team, conversation, and integration boundaries.

categories: forks, clones, mirrors, and related pre/post variants
excluded_families.partition_rule: Every clone, fork, pre/post pair, or shared-upstream derivative remains one family and cannot create an additional held-out family.

execution_sequence: Verify each activated source still resolves to the exact frozen commit and materialize byte-identical content.
Run deterministic deployment canaries and the pinned deterministic scanner configuration; preserve raw artifacts, status, versions, source counts, and snapshot digests.
Create a new repository identity and evaluation-family assignment for each independent upstream; do not reuse or relabel an existing engagement.
Extract features and score every eligible finding with the frozen scoring identity before any human sees a review packet.
Freeze an 8-to-12-entry packet using the outcome-blind selection contract below.
Have analysts review bounded source evidence with abstention available and without classifier scores or expected outcomes.
Recompute compatible cohort counts and OPT-002 gates without changing labels, thresholds, calibration, or the scoring model.

review_selection.ordering: Round-robin activated evaluation families by the primary selection key, selecting at most six entries per family.
eligible_only_if: unique exact-location identity after declared duplicate collapse
not generated, vendored, documentation, example, test, CI, package-hygiene-only, or secret-in-history evidence
review_packet_hides: selection rank rationale beyond stable hash

fail_closed_rules: If source identity, commit, snapshot digest, scanner identity, feature schema, model identity, or calibration drifts, stop and issue a replacement protocol before review.
If fewer than eight eligible candidates exist after activating the reserve, publish the shortfall and stop; do not broaden path tiers or inspect outcomes to refill the packet.
If review yields fewer than four decided compatible labels, fewer than eight genuine evaluation families, or loses either class, retain the evidence but keep OPT-002 gated.
Do not rescore previously reviewed repositories after their labels are known and present that result as independent held-out evidence.
Do not tune, retrain, recalibrate, change thresholds, or add detector rules during this acquisition.

authorization_boundary.next_approval: A separate execution receipt must freeze activated source digests, commands, resource ceilings, output locations, scanner configuration, and whether any network transfer occurs.

promotion_evidence: immutable source and raw scanner digests
stored score identity for every reviewed finding
frozen packet and its outcome-blind input digest
post-review compatible label, class, engagement, and evaluation-family counts
